<documents>
<document id="card-freeze">
FreezingˆandˆunfreezingˆyourˆcardˆFreezingˆyourˆcardˆblocksˆnewˆpurchasesˆandˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆstraightˆaway.ˆIt'sˆtheˆfastestˆthingˆtoˆdoˆifˆyou'veˆmisplacedˆyourˆcardˆandˆthinkˆyouˆmightˆfindˆitˆagain.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆfreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆTapˆCards,ˆchooseˆtheˆcard,ˆandˆswitchˆFreezeˆcardˆon.ˆSwitchˆitˆoffˆtoˆunfreeze.ˆBothˆhappenˆinstantly,ˆandˆyouˆcanˆdoˆitˆasˆoftenˆasˆyouˆlike.ˆ##ˆWhatˆstillˆworksˆwhileˆfrozenˆ-ˆRecurringˆpaymentsˆtoˆmerchantsˆyou'veˆalreadyˆauthorized,ˆsuchˆasˆsubscriptionsˆ-ˆRefundsˆfromˆmerchantsˆ-ˆDepositsˆandˆincomingˆtransfersˆ-ˆYourˆvirtualˆcard,ˆwhichˆhasˆitsˆownˆfreezeˆswitchˆ##ˆFreezeˆorˆreportˆlost?ˆIfˆyou'reˆsureˆtheˆcardˆisˆgoneˆorˆstolen,ˆreportˆitˆlostˆorˆstolenˆinstead.ˆThatˆcancelsˆtheˆcardˆpermanentlyˆandˆletsˆyouˆorderˆaˆreplacement.ˆAˆfreezeˆisˆtemporaryˆandˆreversible.ˆ##ˆFreezeˆversusˆfraudˆlockˆIfˆtheˆappˆsaysˆyourˆcardˆisˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook,ˆthat'sˆaˆfraudˆlock,ˆnotˆaˆfreeze.ˆYouˆcan'tˆremoveˆaˆfraudˆlockˆwithˆtheˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆSeeˆ"WhyˆisˆmyˆcardˆlockedˆbyˆTallowbrook?".ˆSupportˆcanˆalsoˆfreezeˆorˆunfreezeˆyourˆcardˆforˆyouˆifˆyouˆaskˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="card-lost-stolen-v2">
LostˆorˆstolenˆcardˆIfˆyourˆcardˆisˆlostˆorˆstolen,ˆyouˆcanˆdealˆwithˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆinˆaˆcoupleˆofˆminutes.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆcallˆus.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆ**Freezeˆtheˆcard.**ˆTapˆCardsˆandˆswitchˆFreezeˆcardˆon.ˆThisˆstopsˆnewˆpurchasesˆrightˆaway.ˆ2.ˆ**Reportˆit.**ˆIfˆyouˆcan'tˆfindˆit,ˆtapˆReportˆlostˆorˆstolen.ˆThisˆcancelsˆtheˆcardˆpermanently.ˆItˆcan'tˆbeˆundone.ˆ3.ˆ**Addˆaˆvirtualˆcard.**ˆYouˆcanˆcreateˆoneˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆuseˆitˆonlineˆandˆinˆmobileˆwalletsˆrightˆawayˆwhileˆtheˆreplacementˆships.ˆ4.ˆ**Orderˆaˆreplacement.**ˆPickˆstandardˆorˆexpeditedˆshipping.ˆReplacementˆandˆshippingˆfeesˆdependˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆ5.ˆ**Checkˆyourˆtransactions.**ˆDisputeˆanythingˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognize.ˆ##ˆDeliveryˆStandardˆshippingˆtakesˆ7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactionsˆYou'reˆnotˆresponsibleˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆyouˆreportˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆtheyˆfirstˆappearˆon.ˆIfˆyouˆfoundˆyourˆcardˆafterˆfreezingˆit,ˆjustˆunfreezeˆit.ˆNothingˆelseˆchanges.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

response.text: {"answer":"“Locked by Tallowbrook” means your card has a fraud lock, not a freeze. The freeze toggle can’t remove that lock. Please message us in the app so our support team can help.","citations":["card-freeze"],"escalate":true}
